correctness.rationale: Assembling element matrices for lengths (h,1,1,1,1) gives P=(M+tK)^(-1)M; the pinned exact symbolic verifier computes det(6h(M+tK)) with positive factors for h>=1,t>=0, all 20 directed off-diagonal numerators and five positive diagonal numerators. In the 10 reflection orbits every entry for t>=1/6 except positions (0,2),(1,4) has a positive sign; those two have factor t F_h(t), while (0,3) forces negativity for 0<t<1/6. The cubic F has one positive zero by Descartes sign changes, with F(1/6)=-36(h-1)(h+1) and F(h²/6)=h(h-1)²(h+1)³(h+2). Thus t=0 or t>=rho(h), rho(1)=1/6, strict bound for h>1; expansion F(h/6+c)=6(c-3)h³+O_c(h²) proves rho=h/6+3+o(1). Separate exact-rational assembled-matrix checks verified five ratios (1,1.5,2,5,20), eight timesteps per ratio. The independent finite checks alone do not prove polynomial identities for all h,t.
